title: German-Style BBQ Pork Burger
description: A twist on the classic burger, featuring a sweet and tangy German-inspired BBQ sauce, topped with glazed pork and crispy onions.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together BBQ sauce, Jamaican seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Brush the BBQ sauce mixture onto both sides of the pork burgers.
Grill the burgers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill.
Top each burger with a slice of cheese, if using.
Add a few slices of glazed onions on top of the cheese.
Assemble the burgers with lettuce, tomato, and a dollop of the remaining BBQ sauce.
